speech.wav is built from these MSWC clips (Multilingual Spoken Words Corpus, CC-BY 4.0,
https://mlcommons.org/datasets/multilingual-spoken-words/), rescaled, with gaps and a
-60 dBFS noise floor added. noise.wav is synthetic.
